artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime and $\mathbb{F}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. An arithmetic progression in $\mathbb{F}_p$ of length $\ell$ is a set of the form $\{a, a+d, a+2d, \dots, a+(\ell-1)d\} \subset \mathbb{F}_p$ for some $a \in \mathbb{F}_p$ and $d \in \mathbb{F}_p \setminus \{0\}$.

For an integer $n \geq 2$ and prime $p$, define
$$\ell_n(p) = \min\{\ell : \text{every } n\text{-element subset of } \mathbb{F}_p \text{ is contained in some arithmetic progression of length } \ell\}.$$

It is known that for $n \geq 4$ and $p \to \infty$,
$$p^{\,1 - \frac{1}{n-1}}(1+o(1)) \;<\; \ell_n(p) \;<\; \binom{2n-2}{n-1}^{\!\frac{1}{n-1}}\, p^{\,1 - \frac{1}{n-1}}.$$

Determine whether
$$\ell_n(p) \;=\; \binom{2n-2}{n-1}^{\!\frac{1}{n-1}} \, p^{\,1 - \frac{1}{n-1}}\,(1+o(1)) \qquad \text{as } p \to \infty,$$
for each fixed integer $n \geq 4$; that is, prove or disprove this asymptotic equality.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published proof or disproof of the asymptotic for $\ell_n(p)$ for $n \geq 4$. The problem appears in standard lists of open problems in additive combinatorics and only matching upper/lower bounds of the form $C \cdot p^{1-1/(n-1)}$ (with non-matching constants) seem to be known. The case $n=3$ is settled and $n=2$ is trivial; the general case for $n \geq 4$ is reported as open.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Additive Combinatorics (Croot-Lev)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists problems on covering subsets of F_p by arithmetic progressions, with bounds p^{1-1/(n-1)}(1+o(1)) < l_n(p) < C_n p^{1-1/(n-1)} for n >= 4.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated as an open problem with only non-matching upper and lower bounds known for n >= 4.
